init.title: Klereo Connect
init.description: How often the pool is read from the Klereo server, from 5 minutes to one hour. A longer interval eases the load on the Klereo server, at the cost of less recent readings.

out_read_only.message: {name} cannot be driven from Home Assistant: the controller has not said which states it accepts — or, on the heating and the disinfectant, what the pool is equipped with.

out_mode_no_switching.message: {name} is in {mode} mode, which only accepts the state the controller already has: switching it on or off there is not defined. Change the mode first.

out_mode_ambiguous_state.message: {name} cannot be set to mode {mode} from Home Assistant: that mode accepts several states and none of them leaves the output as it is, so there is no safe choice to make on your behalf.

out_speed_not_settable.message: {name} cannot be set while the output is in {mode}: only Manuel takes a speed. Change the mode first.

account_read_only.message: {name} cannot be changed: this Klereo account only has access level {access} on the pool, and commands need level 10 or above. Ask whoever administers the pool to raise it.

out_needs_full_access.message: {name} cannot be driven: Klereo reserves the pH corrector, the disinfectant, the flocculant and hybrid chlorine to access level 16 on the pool, and this account has {access}. The other outputs work from level 10.

command_failed.message: {name} could not be changed: Klereo did not accept the command ({error}).
